label: champ_0010_chairman_01
text: Very well, Champion Nemona. I trust you to\nhandle this in my stead.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: champ_0010_rival_00
text: Sure thing! You can count on me. In fact, I bet\nthis is gonna be fun![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_chairman_02
text: I’m glad to hear it. Good day, then.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: champ_0010_chairman_03
text: Oh—pardon me.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: champ_0010_select_03
text: Who was that?

label: champ_0010_select_04
text: She looked awesome!

label: champ_0010_rival_16a
text:
Piqued your interest, huh? That lady is...
Well, they call her La Primera!\c
She’s strong, she can do pretty much anything,
she’s got cool practically coming out her ears...\c
She’s basically everything I wanna be—or that
any Pokémon Trainer would wanna be, really![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_16b
text:
Good eye! She sure is! That lady is... Well, they
call her La Primera!\c
She’s strong, she can do pretty much anything,
she’s got cool practically coming out her ears...\c
She’s basically everything I wanna be—or that
any Pokémon Trainer would wanna be, really![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_17
text: Oh! Which reminds me! Remember in homeroom\nwhen I asked what your dream is?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_02a
text: Now, I know you said you’re all about completing\nthe Pokédex! But hear me out...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_02b
text: Well, since your heart’s already set on becoming\na really strong Trainer...I’ve got an idea for you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_02c
text: If you’re still trying to decide what it is you’re\nlooking for...I’ve got an idea for you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_03
text: You should try to reach [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Champion Rank[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] like me![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_slect_01
text: Yeah, I will!

label: champ_0010_slect_02
text: I don’t know...

label: champ_0010_rival_04a
text: Oh wow! Hang on, though—I’ve got a whole spiel\nI wanna give you. Here goes...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_04b
text: Aww, but talent like yours deserves to be used!\nHear me out...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_05
text:
The Trainers who reach Champion Rank are the
ones who raise their Pokémon really strong.\c
They’re pro-tier battlers. Their moves keep
crowds absolutely on the edge of their seats![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_06
text: You have to prove yourself to the Pokémon\nLeague to officially get the title of Champion.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_07
text:
And to do that, you have to do more than just
take classes here.\c
You’ve got to take on eight Pokémon Gyms and
win so you can collect their Gym Badges![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_08
text: Once you’ve done all that, all that’s left is a\nspecial test—the Champion Assessment.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_09
text: And once you pass THAT, then at long last you’ll\nbe a Champion![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_10
text: It’s every Pokémon Trainer’s dream! The coolest\ntitle anyone could ever hope to get!\c\nNot to brag or anything![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_11
text: I reached Champion Rank during our last\nTreasure Hunt, you know![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_16
text:
Oh, the Treasure Hunt is a special independent
study thing we’ve got here. Should happen soon!\c
Our last one started not long after the beginning
of this school year![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_12
text: It’s great! You get to leave school to go have an\nadventure and learn however you want![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_13
text: I guess you could say my journey to becoming\na Champion was the treasure I found...maybe?\r\nI dunno yet if that’s the answer I’m looking for...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_14
text: Anyway, I’ve got a feeling I’d be able to get even\nstronger if you and I were both working at it...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_18
text: Lemme go ahead and save the Gyms’ locations in\nyour map app in case you decide to go for it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0010_rival_15
text: Give it some thought![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
